value.name: asha waits beside her father
value.description: Asha stays with her father, pressing his hand and waiting while the portal cursor blinks and the proxy field remains empty.
evidence: She pressed her thumb a little harder into her father's hand and waited, the cursor in the portal still blinking where the proxy field was empty.

value.name: asha calls trenton desk
value.description: Asha leaves Marcus's text unanswered and calls the Trenton facility desk to ask about the Bridgepoint transfer.
evidence: Asha left Marcus's half-finished text unanswered and dialed the Trenton facility's main desk from her cell
she gave her name, her father's room number, and asked plainly whether the attending had acknowledged the page about the Bridgepoint transfer

value.name: supervisor appears and withdraws
value.description: While Asha waits on hold, the supervisor briefly reappears at the doorway and then leaves again.
evidence: the desk clerk put her on hold, and the small tinned music came through the receiver while the supervisor's careful face reappeared at the doorway, then withdrew again

value.name: daniel orders interference stopped
value.description: Daniel texts Asha to stop interfering and to fill in the proxy field so he can handle Marcus.
evidence: Daniel's text dropped onto the screen above Marcus's stalled reply—Stop interfering. I'm handling Marcus. Just fill in the proxy field and get this done—

value.name: asha ignores daniel's message
value.description: Asha reads Daniel's text and leaves it unanswered, refusing to give him the sense that he still belongs at the table.
evidence: she read it once and set the phone face-up on the blanket without typing back, because answering would tell him he still had a seat at this table

value.name: doctor promised within hour
value.description: The clerk returns to say the doctor will come within the hour to write the order, and Asha thanks her and asks her name for future contact.
evidence: The clerk came back on the line to say the doctor would be in within the hour to write the order
Asha thanked her by name and asked for the clerk's name in return, so that when she called again there would be a person on the other end who had already said yes

value.name: asha replies to marcus
value.description: Asha tells Marcus to ignore the noise and identify the proxy instead of engaging with the surrounding conflict.
evidence: Asha thumbed a single line back to Marcus on top of his stalled reply—Ignore the noise. Just tell me who the proxy is.—and set the phone down beside the laptop without watching for the typing dots
